source: API Specification v4.0.0 (requirement/legacy/05-technical-architecture/recovery-workbench-api-specification-v4.yaml); story file v7 RWB-E1-043 sections 9, 12, 13; story file v7 RWB-E1-019 section 12 (rollback); RWB-E1-042 spec revision 3 (output/INC-003-epic-1-RWB-E1-042/specify/spec.md) sections 11.2, 12.1; run decisions D-RUN-10 and D-RUN-11 (orchestrator, Claude Code, an AI agent)

featureFlags.rwb.p3.refdata-versions: registry branch (this story); default false, true in local profile (SPEC-018)
featureFlags.mapping: controller mapped when either flag is on; a request routed to a branch whose flag is off gets 404 MSG-P4-003; both off: no mapping

loadByTable: code with a registered ReferenceTableHandler -> registry handler path (SPEC-025, D-RUN-11)
otherwise -> registry built-in path; unknown code refused 422 MSG-P3-027 'table code is not a reference table' (SPEC-002)
dispatch.note: data_product is not refused by design: RWB-E1-001 registers its handler (D-RUN-11); until then it is an unknown code (TC-HD-03)

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.loader.<table>; missing key or empty value refuses (SPEC-027)

fields.file: CSV (RFC 4180, UTF-8, header row) or XLSX (first sheet) (A-21)
fields.table: one of the 12 story BR1 codes with a column definition, a registered handler code, or PARAMETER
fields.validFrom: ISO date, >= current business date (BusinessDateProvider, SPEC-017)

201.note: also returned for an identical repeat (A-06); PARAMETER repeat=true also 201

403.audit: one REFUSED REFERENCE_LOAD_AUDIT event, no user ID (SPEC-028)

409.when: approved version already has this validFrom; numbering race with different content (A-15)

422.when: table code, column definition, row, key, handler validate or validFrom check failed; no data rows; missing field; detail lists every failed row (max 100)

503.when: store unavailable or no business date (A-01, A-22)

endpoints.delegatesTo: ReferenceVersionRegistry#approve (calls ReferenceTableHandler#apply for a handler code; VersionDecisionRecorder) | ParameterLoadHandler#approve

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.approver.<table of loadId> (SPEC-027)

200.note: registry: repeat approval returns the same body, no change; PARAMETER branch follows RWB-E1-042 (GAP-35)

404.when: unknown loadId or branch flag off

409.when: author approves; concurrent change or handler apply failure; not approvable or validFrom passed (A-16, A-17)

503.when: store unavailable or no business date

endpoints.delegatesTo: ReferenceVersionRegistry#rollback (calls ReferenceTableHandler#onRolledBack for a handler code) | ParameterLoadHandler#rollback

capability.tableRight: role in CODE_LIST rwb.refload.loader.<table of loadId> (SPEC-027)

headers.Idempotency-Key: optional; accepted, not stored (state-based repeat, A-27)

200.note: repeat on a ROLLED_BACK load returns the current body, nothing written

404.when: unknown loadId or branch flag off

409.when: load not approved; not the latest approved version; handler without rollback; no earlier approved version (MSG-P3-015); concurrent change

notBuiltHere.reason: not in story section 13 build steps; owner to be named (GAP-34, open item)

types: ReferenceTableHandler (SPI: tableCode, validate, apply, supportsRollback, onRolledBack, changeSummary)
publishedJavaInterfaces.signatures: story file v7 section 12 verbatim for the S7 types; ReferenceTableHandler first three methods verbatim from story file v7 RWB-E1-001 section 12; rollback per SPEC-024

audit: REFERENCE_LOAD_AUDIT structured line per load, approve, rollback, done and refused: operation, table, loadId, area, right, outcome, messageCode, traceId, changes; no user ID (SPEC-028)
problemBody: application/problem+json: type, title, status, detail, messageCode, messageTh, field, traceId (API Specification v4 Problem)
